name: Pipeliners - Rank Gap Audit 2026-09-18
body:
> Report · Pipeliners · 2026-09-18

# Summary
Audit of the keywords Semrush showed at #2 and on page 2 (US desktop, Sep 15 to 16) checked against GSC (https property via the Search Atlas API). Built as a sheet-style HTML report on Sep 18. Changes C6 to C8 were applied Sep 17; the rest was pending.

# Key findings
- 25 qualifying keywords, 0 clicks in every window (7 days, 28 days, 3 months).
- "trenchless sewer repair mesa" at #2 in Semrush is the GBP / local-pack slot (credited to the GBP UTM URL), not an organic page. Organically /mesa/ sits around position 42 (pages 4 to 7).
- 7 rows actionable now on 4 pages not edited in the last two weeks (San Tan Valley 2, Paradise Valley 3, Apache Junction 1, Fort McDowell 1). 8 rows on HOLD on pages edited Sep 15 to 16 (Buckeye, Fountain Hills, Florence) until their scheduled reads (Buckeye Sep 30, others Oct 9). 5 monitor, 5 excluded.
- Semrush "-54% traffic" is a modeled estimate; GSC real clicks were flat to slightly down. Do not report -54% as a real loss.
- GSC and Semrush disagree by 10 to 40 positions on several city terms.

# Decisions and status
- Risks to avoid: re-editing pages mid-measurement, H1 fixes that bypass the OTTO override layer, chasing false relevance (gas, competitor brands).
- GBP-side moves are report-only (Kim's call).

# Files in this folder (rollups only)
- `pipeliners-rank-gap-audit.html`: the audit sheet.
- `gsc_windows.csv`: GSC metrics per keyword per window.
- `sheet-template.html`, `crawl.json`, `build.py`: build files.
